info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts-v2-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts API provides a way to access available discounts on auto insurance quotes. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a curated list of discount options, facilitating better pricing for consumers looking to save on their insurance premiums. Typical consumers of this API include insurance agents, brokers, and price comparison websites seeking to enhance their offerings. By integrating this API, developers can offer their users customized quote options that reflect potential savings through various discounts.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the various discounts that can be applied to quotes. It provides valuable information for pricing adjustments and promotional offers applicable to client proposals.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters necessary to retrieve discount quotes. Ensure you include all required fields to get accurate results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of applicable discount quotes.
